g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in (the user chooses to play). The offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today), 'Not now' leaves home unchanged, and the ad-fail path hides the card or shows a retry note.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers until midnight. It has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days without a session, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing (removes nothing free: yes) and adds a paid-mode sample on top of what free users have.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card is app chrome on s01 Chats home, which is rated safe. It is not in the conversation or over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is a listed paywall feature (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The paywall lists the feature (s02.e03) and the Luzia+ badge exists on s01 (s01.e02). The claim that no free-tier limit was observed matches the open questions, and the reward is labeled an inference.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is limited to 3 answers until midnight, shown only after a 3+ day gap, so it is a quantity- and time-limited sample.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on app open on the home screen, before the user starts a task, and is dismissible.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game with a detectable app-event trigger. The reward is only granted on a confirmed play, and an unconfirmed play shows a retry note.

c7_specific.reason: It names Luzia's Advanced reasoning mode paywall feature, the Luzia+ badge and the Chats home layout, and it points to the 3-day trial button.

other_concern: The reward depends on a per-answer Advanced reasoning mode that was not observed in the chat UI. That is an implementation detail rather than a claim about the app. The 'drop to 1 answer in lower-earning markets' note is out of scope.
